title.en: Lazio fight back to beat Cagliari 2-1 and go three clear at Serie A summit
title.zh_hant: 拉素2:1反勝卡利亞里　六連勝獨佔意甲榜首
title.zh_hans: 拉素2:1反胜卡利亚里　六连胜独占意甲榜首

summary.en: Gennaro Gattuso's Lazio consolidated top spot in Serie A on Sunday with a 2-1 comeback win over Cagliari, making it six straight league victories. The visitors took the lead through M'Bala Nzola in the 20th minute before Gustav Isaksen levelled in the 36th and substitute Andrea Pinamonti headed the winner in the 83rd. With 28 points from 10 games, Lazio moved three clear of Inter after the Nerazzurri lost the Milan derby. It is the best start to a league campaign in the club's history; Lazio last won Serie A in 2000.
summary.zh_hant: 加度素帶領嘅拉素喺意甲第10輪主場2:1反勝卡利亞里，聯賽六連勝，28分獨佔榜首，拋離輸咗米蘭打吡嘅國際米蘭3分。卡利亞里由尼索拉20分鐘先開紀錄，伊沙臣36分鐘勁射扳平，後備入替嘅比拿蒙迪83分鐘頂入奠勝。拉素今季10戰8勝2和保持不敗，係隊史最佳聯賽開局；球會上次捧意甲已經係2000年嘅事。
summary.zh_hans: 加图索带领的拉素在意甲第10轮主场2:1反胜卡利亚里，联赛六连胜，28分独占榜首，抛离输了米兰德比的国际米兰3分。卡利亚里由尼索拉20分钟先开纪录，伊萨臣36分钟劲射扳平，后备入替的比拿蒙迪83分钟顶入奠胜。拉素今季10战8胜2和保持不败，是队史最佳联赛开局；球会上次捧意甲已经是2000年的事。

title.en: Roma hit four before half-time in 5-2 rout of Udinese to stay unbeaten
title.zh_hant: 羅馬半場轟4球5:2大勝烏甸尼斯　緊貼榜首
title.zh_hans: 罗马半场轰4球5:2大胜乌甸尼斯　紧贴榜首

summary.en: AS Roma blew away Udinese 5-2 on Saturday to stay unbeaten in Serie A, racing into a 4-0 half-time lead. Bryan Cristante opened the scoring in the 10th minute before Rodrigo Mora, Donyell Malen and Evan Ndicka struck between the 31st and 37th minutes. Udinese pulled two back through Nicolo Zaniolo and Matteo Palma after the break, but Daniele Ghilardi sealed it in stoppage time. Gian Piero Gasperini's side have 24 points from 10 games, sitting third behind leaders Lazio.
summary.zh_hant: 羅馬喺意甲第10輪作客5:2大勝烏甸尼斯，半場已經領先4:0，繼續保持不敗。基斯坦迪10分鐘先開紀錄，摩拉、馬倫同尼迪卡喺31至37分鐘連入3球；烏甸尼斯下半場由辛尼奧路同柏馬追返兩球，基拉迪補時射入第5球。加斯柏連尼嘅球隊10戰得24分排第三，緊貼榜首拉素。
summary.zh_hans: 罗马在意甲第10轮作客5:2大胜乌甸尼斯，半场已经领先4:0，继续保持不败。基斯坦迪10分钟先开纪录，摩拉、马伦和尼迪卡在31至37分钟连入3球；乌甸尼斯下半场由辛尼奥路和柏马追回两球，基拉迪补时射入第5球。加斯柏连尼的球队10战得24分排第三，紧贴榜首拉素。

title.en: Messias inspires Genoa to third straight win with 2-1 victory at Lecce
title.zh_hant: 米斯亞斯一射一傳　熱拿亞2:1作客挫萊切三連勝
title.zh_hans: 米斯亚斯一射一传　热拿亚2:1作客挫莱切三连胜

summary.en: Genoa made it three consecutive Serie A wins with a 2-1 victory away to Lecce on Sunday, a result that could prove crucial in the relegation battle. Milutin Osmajic turned in Junior Messias' cross for the opener in the 11th minute, and Messias doubled the lead in the 28th with a fine finish from a tight angle after being released by Stephan El Shaarawy. Lecce pulled one back through Youssef Maleh's deflected free kick in the 40th minute but could not find an equaliser.
summary.zh_hant: 熱拿亞喺意甲第10輪作客2:1擊敗萊切，聯賽三連勝，護級路上攞到關鍵3分。奧斯馬治11分鐘接應米斯亞斯傳送先開紀錄，米斯亞斯28分鐘接應艾沙拉維妙傳，窄角度笠過門將射成2:0；萊切由馬利40分鐘罰球省中人牆折射追返一球，但未能扳平。米斯亞斯一射一傳成為贏波功臣。
summary.zh_hans: 热拿亚在意甲第10轮作客2:1击败莱切，联赛三连胜，护级路上拿到关键3分。奥斯马治11分钟接应米斯亚斯传送先开纪录，米斯亚斯28分钟接应艾沙拉维妙传，窄角度笠过门将射成2:0；莱切由马利40分钟罚球省中人墙折射追回一球，但未能扳平。米斯亚斯一射一传成为赢波功臣。

title.en: Antonelli seals F1 title with third in Mexico as Verstappen wins chaotic race
title.zh_hant: 維斯塔潘墨西哥站險勝咸美頓　安東尼利季軍加冕史上最年輕F1世界冠軍
title.zh_hans: 维斯塔潘墨西哥站险胜咸美顿　安东尼利季军加冕史上最年轻F1世界冠军

summary.en: Kimi Antonelli became the youngest Formula 1 world champion in history at 20, clinching the 2026 drivers' title with third place in a dramatic Mexico City Grand Prix. Max Verstappen won the race by 0.799 seconds from Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton, his third win of the season and 74th career victory, in a race interrupted by a red flag after Valtteri Bottas' heavy crash on lap 46. Antonelli, who only needed ninth place to seal the title, is the first Italian champion since Alberto Ascari in 1953 and delivered Mercedes' first drivers' crown since Hamilton's in 2020. Ferrari team-mates Hamilton and Charles Leclerc collided on the opening lap, with Leclerc later given a five-second penalty for cutting the corner.
summary.zh_hant: 20歲嘅安東尼利喺戲劇性嘅墨西哥城大獎賽攞季軍，提前加冕2026年F1車手世界冠軍，成為史上最年輕嘅F1世界冠軍。維斯塔潘以0.799秒力壓法拉利嘅咸美頓奪冠，係今季第3勝、生涯第74勝；比賽因為保達斯第46圈大炒車而出示紅旗中斷。安東尼利今仗只需要第9名就封王，最終以季軍完成，係1953年阿斯卡利以嚟首位意大利世界冠軍，亦幫平治攞到自2020年咸美頓之後首個車手冠軍。法拉利雙雄咸美頓同勒克萊爾開賽圈相撞，勒克萊爾之後因為抄捷徑被罰5秒。
summary.zh_hans: 20岁的安东尼利在戏剧性的墨西哥城大奖赛拿季军，提前加冕2026年F1车手世界冠军，成为史上最年轻的F1世界冠军。维斯塔潘以0.799秒力压法拉利的咸美顿夺冠，是今季第3胜、生涯第74胜；比赛因为保达斯第46圈大撞车而出示红旗中断。安东尼利今仗只需要第9名就封王，最终以季军完成，是1953年阿斯卡利以来首位意大利世界冠军，亦帮平治拿到自2020年咸美顿之后首个车手冠军。法拉利双雄咸美顿和勒克莱尔开赛圈相撞，勒克莱尔之后因为抄捷径被罚5秒。

title.en: Juventus beat 10-man Napoli 2-0 to climb to seventh in Serie A
title.zh_hant: 祖雲達斯2:0挫十人拿玻里　升上意甲第七
title.zh_hans: 尤文图斯2:0挫十人拿玻里　升上意甲第七

summary.en: Juventus beat Napoli 2-0 at the Allianz Stadium in Serie A, their first home win since September 20, moving up to seventh on 17 points. Kerim Alajbegovic curled home his first Serie A goal in the 70th minute before Napoli's Luca Marianucci was sent off for a second yellow card five minutes later. Substitute Jérémie Boga sealed the win with a fine curling finish in the 87th minute. Napoli, who started the day level on 14 points with Juve, drop to eighth, six points off the Champions League places.
summary.zh_hant: 祖雲達斯喺意甲主場2:0擊敗拿玻里，自9月20日以嚟首度喺主場贏波，升上第7位得17分。艾拿積比高域70分鐘禁區外遠射中柱入網，射入個人首個意甲入球；拿玻里嘅馬利安奴治5分鐘後兩黃一紅被逐。後備上陣嘅波加87分鐘右腳曲線射入遠柱鎖定勝局。賽前同祖記同積14分嘅拿玻里跌落第8，落後歐聯區6分。
summary.zh_hans: 尤文图斯在意甲主场2:0击败拿玻里，自9月20日以来首次在主场赢波，升上第7位得17分。艾拿积比高域70分钟禁区外远射中柱入网，射入个人首个意甲入球；拿玻里的马利安奴治5分钟后两黄一红被逐。后备上阵的波加87分钟右脚曲线射入远柱锁定胜局。赛前和祖记同积14分的拿玻里跌落第8，落后欧联区6分。

title.en: Tatum scores 32 as Celtics beat Magic 108-97 for fifth straight win
title.zh_hant: 塔圖姆32分　塞爾特人108:97挫魔術五連勝
title.zh_hans: 塔图姆32分　塞尔特人108:97挫魔术五连胜

summary.en: Jayson Tatum scored 32 points as the Boston Celtics beat the Orlando Magic 108-97 for their fifth consecutive win, improving to 5-1. Orlando cut the deficit to 97-93 in the fourth quarter before Boston closed the game with an 11-4 run, with Neemias Queta coming up with a key block. The Magic drop to 2-4.
summary.zh_hant: 塞爾特人作客108:97擊敗魔術，豪取五連勝，戰績5勝1負。塔圖姆攻入32分（8/19投籃、罰球17中15）；魔術第四節一度追至97:93，塞軍最後4分鐘打出一波11:4收工，基達關鍵封阻建功。魔術跌至2勝4負。
summary.zh_hans: 塞尔特人作客108:97击败魔术，豪取五连胜，战绩5胜1负。塔图姆攻入32分（8/19投篮、罚球17中15）；魔术第四节一度追至97:93，塞军最后4分钟打出一波11:4收工，基达关键封阻建功。魔术跌至2胜4负。

title.en: Havertz ends 14-year Anfield hoodoo as Arsenal go three clear at the top
title.zh_hant: 夏維斯一箭定江山　阿仙奴14年來首度喺晏菲路贏波　領先3分居榜首
title.zh_hans: 夏维斯一箭定江山　阿仙奴14年来首度在晏菲路赢波　领先3分居榜首

summary.en: Arsenal beat Liverpool 1-0 at Anfield, their first league win there in 14 years, to move three points clear at the top of the Premier League. Kai Havertz tapped in Declan Rice's low cross in the 16th minute after an Alisson error, becoming the highest-scoring German in Premier League history with 46 goals, one more than Ilkay Gundogan. Liverpool dominated long spells and hit the bar through Florian Wirtz but failed to land a shot on target at home for the first time on record. Arsenal have 24 points from nine games; Liverpool stay fifth, nine points behind.
summary.zh_hant: 阿仙奴作客1:0擊敗利物浦，14年來首次喺晏菲路贏波，拋離曼城3分獨佔英超榜首。艾利臣開龍門球失誤，懷斯16分鐘右路地波傳中，夏維斯遠柱撞射入網；呢球係夏維斯第46個英超入球，超越根度簡成為英超史上入球最多嘅德國球員。利物浦長時間圍攻，韋斯曾中楣，但全場竟然冇一次中目標射門，係有紀錄以嚟首次喺主場咁頹。阿仙奴9戰24分；利物浦續排第5，落後9分。
summary.zh_hans: 阿仙奴作客1:0击败利物浦，14年来首次在晏菲路赢波，抛离曼城3分独占英超榜首。艾利臣开龙门球失误，怀斯16分钟右路地波传中，夏维斯远柱撞射入网；这球是夏维斯第46个英超入球，超越根度简成为英超史上入球最多的德国球员。利物浦长时间围攻，韦斯曾中楣，但全场竟然没有一次中目标射门，是有纪录以来首次在主场这么颓。阿仙奴9战24分；利物浦续排第5，落后9分。

title.en: Porter scores 23 as Nets beat Pacers 98-90 for first win of season
title.zh_hant: 波特23分領軍　籃網98:90挫溜馬開季首勝
title.zh_hans: 波特23分领军　篮网98:90挫溜马开季首胜

summary.en: Michael Porter Jr. scored 23 points and Julius Randle added 20 as the Brooklyn Nets secured their first win of the season with a 98-90 victory over the Indiana Pacers at Gainbridge Fieldhouse on Sunday. Day'Ron Sharpe collected 15 points and 13 rebounds and Nolan Traore scored 16 for Brooklyn, who led the entire second half and never trailed after the first quarter. Andrew Nembhard paced Indiana with 23 points and Pascal Siakam had 17, but the Pacers dropped their fourth straight game to fall to 2-5, with Brooklyn improving to 1-5.
summary.zh_hant: 波特（Michael Porter Jr.）攻入23分、蘭度（Julius Randle）貢獻20分，帶領布魯克林籃網作客98:90擊敗印第安納溜馬，拎到今季首勝。沙普（Day'Ron Sharpe）攞下15分13籃板「雙雙」，查奧利（Nolan Traore）得16分；籃網下半場全程領先，首節之後再冇落後過，戰績改寫為1勝5負。溜馬嘅林伯特（Andrew Nembhard）得23分、施亞甘（Pascal Siakam）17分，但球隊四連敗，跌至2勝5負。
summary.zh_hans: 波特（Michael Porter Jr.）攻入23分、兰度（Julius Randle）贡献20分，带领布鲁克林篮网作客98:90击败印第安纳溜马，拿到今季首胜。沙普（Day'Ron Sharpe）拿下15分13篮板「双双」，查奥利（Nolan Traore）得16分；篮网下半场全程领先，首节之后再没落后过，战绩改写为1胜5负。溜马的林伯特（Andrew Nembhard）得23分、施亚甘（Pascal Siakam）17分，但球队四连败，跌至2胜5负。

title.en: Afghanistan beat Australia by four wickets to claim maiden Hong Kong Sixes title
title.zh_hant: 阿富汗以4 wicket之差挫澳洲　歷史性首奪香港六人板球賽冠軍
title.zh_hans: 阿富汗以4 wicket之差挫澳洲　历史性首夺香港六人板球赛冠军

summary.en: Afghanistan won their maiden Hong Kong Sixes title on Sunday, beating Australia by four wickets in the Cup final at Mission Road Ground in Mong Kok. Chasing 116, Afghanistan reached 119 for 2 in just 5.1 overs, with Imran Mir smashing an unbeaten 53 off 14 balls, including seven sixes, to earn Player of the Match honours. Farmanullah Safi finished unbeaten on 26 off seven deliveries. Australia, who won the toss and batted first, posted 115 for 4 in their six overs, led by Max Bryant's 44 off 14 balls. Captain Gulbadin Naib's side went through the tournament unbeaten, beating South Africa and Oman in the group stage and Scotland in the semi-final, and became the eighth nation to lift the Hong Kong Sixes trophy. Pakistan claimed the Plate title.
summary.zh_hant: 阿富汗周日喺旺角 Mission Road 球場嘅香港六人板球賽盃賽決賽，以4 wicket之差擊敗澳洲，歷史性首次捧走冠軍。澳洲掟贏硬幣先攻，六個回合攞115分失4個 wicket，麥拜仁（Max Bryant）14球轟44分；阿富汗追116分，只用咗5.1個回合就以119分2個出局完成反勝。伊姆蘭·米爾（Imran Mir）14球53分不敗、轟出7個六分球，獲選決賽最佳球員；法爾曼奴拿·薩菲（Farmanullah Safi）7球26分不敗。古爾巴丁·拿比（Gulbadin Naib）帶領嘅阿富汗今屆全勝奪標——分組賽贏南非同阿曼、四強挫蘇格蘭，成為史上第8支捧盃嘅球隊；Plate 組別冠軍由巴基斯坦奪得。
summary.zh_hans: 阿富汗周日在旺角 Mission Road 球场的香港六人板球赛杯赛决赛，以4 wicket之差击败澳洲，历史性首次捧走冠军。澳洲掷赢硬币先攻，六个回合拿115分失4个 wicket，麦拜仁（Max Bryant）14球轰44分；阿富汗追116分，只用了5.1个回合就以119分2个出局完成反胜。伊姆兰·米尔（Imran Mir）14球53分不败、轰出7个六分球，获选决赛最佳球员；法尔曼奴拿·萨菲（Farmanullah Safi）7球26分不败。古尔巴丁·拿比（Gulbadin Naib）带领的阿富汗今届全胜夺标——分组赛赢南非和阿曼、四强挫苏格兰，成为史上第8支捧杯的球队；Plate 组别冠军由巴基斯坦夺得。

title.en: Lendeborg drops career-high 37 as Warriors beat Clippers 124-112 for fourth straight win
title.zh_hant: 蘭杜堡37分生涯新高　勇士124:112挫快艇四連勝
title.zh_hans: 兰杜堡37分生涯新高　勇士124:112挫快艇四连胜

summary.en: Rookie Yaxel Lendeborg scored a career-high 37 points on 13-for-19 shooting, including six three-pointers, as the Golden State Warriors beat the Los Angeles Clippers 124-112 at Chase Center on Sunday for their fourth straight win, despite resting Stephen Curry and Draymond Green on the first night of a back-to-back. The 11th overall pick of the 2026 draft added four rebounds and six assists, recording the highest score by a Warriors rookie since Curry's 42-point game in 2010. De'Anthony Melton scored 21 points and Brandon Williams and Brandin Podziemski added 17 each as Golden State improved to 4-3. The Clippers led 37-29 after the first quarter before the Warriors took a 63-57 half-time lead; Rui Hachimura scored a team-high 24 for Los Angeles, who suffered their fifth consecutive defeat. Curry and Green are expected to return when the Warriors host the Phoenix Suns on Monday night.
summary.zh_hant: 勇士新秀蘭杜堡（Yaxel Lendeborg）轟入生涯新高37分，帶領喺背靠背首戰輪休史提芬居里（Stephen Curry）同特雷蒙格連（Draymond Green）嘅金州勇士，主場124:112擊敗洛杉磯快艇，豪取四連勝。呢位2026年選秀第11順位新秀13射19中、投中6球三分，另加4籃板6助攻，係居里喺2010年新秀年轟42分之後，勇士新秀單場最高分。米爾頓（De'Anthony Melton）得21分，威廉斯（Brandon Williams）同波錫姆斯基（Brandin Podziemski）各得17分；勇士首節落後29:37，半場反超63:57，戰績改寫為4勝3負。快艇嘅八村壘得全隊最高24分，球隊五連敗。勇士聽晚主場迎戰太陽，居里同格連預計復出。
summary.zh_hans: 勇士新秀兰杜堡（Yaxel Lendeborg）轰入生涯新高37分，带领在背靠背首战轮休史提芬居里（Stephen Curry）同特雷蒙格连（Draymond Green）的金州勇士，主场124:112击败洛杉矶快艇，豪取四连胜。这位2026年选秀第11顺位新秀13射19中、投中6球三分，另加4篮板6助攻，是居里在2010年新秀年轰42分之后，勇士新秀单场最高分。米尔顿（De'Anthony Melton）得21分，威廉斯（Brandon Williams）同波锡姆斯基（Brandin Podziemski）各得17分；勇士首节落后29:37，半场反超63:57，战绩改写为4胜3负。快艇的八村垒得全队最高24分，球队五连败。勇士听晚主场迎战太阳，居里同格连预计复出。

title.en: Doncic scores 45 as Lakers hold off Raptors 131-125
title.zh_hant: 當錫45分15籃板　湖人131:125險勝速龍
title.zh_hans: 当锡45分15篮板　湖人131:125险胜速龙

summary.en: Luka Doncic scored 45 points and grabbed a season-high 15 rebounds with six assists and five steals as the Los Angeles Lakers beat the Toronto Raptors 131-125 at Crypto.com Arena on Sunday night. Doncic hit eight three-pointers and scored at least 37 points for a fourth consecutive game, leading the Lakers to a 26-point lead early in the third quarter. Austin Reaves added 19 points and Walker Kessler had 16 points and 15 rebounds for Los Angeles, who improved to 5-2. The Raptors rallied with the Lakers' starters benched, trimming the deficit to five points with 43.7 seconds left before the Lakers closed out the win. Scottie Barnes scored 29 points and RJ Barrett added 22 for Toronto, who fell to 3-3 with Kawhi Leonard missing a fourth straight game with a knee injury.
summary.zh_hant: 盧卡當錫（Luka Doncic）轟入45分、抓下今季新高15個籃板，另加6助攻5偷波，帶領洛杉磯湖人主場131:125險勝多倫多速龍。當錫投中8球三分，連續第四場攻入最少37分，幫湖人喺第三節初段領先26分。列夫斯（Austin Reaves）得19分，基斯拿（Walker Kessler）16分15籃板；湖人戰績改寫為5勝2負。速龍喺湖人收起正選嗰陣掀起反撲，最後43.7秒追到只差5分，最後功虧一簣。速龍嘅巴尼斯（Scottie Barnes）得29分、巴列特（RJ Barrett）22分；球隊跌至3勝3負，卡維李安納（Kawhi Leonard）膝傷連續缺陣第四場。
summary.zh_hans: 卢卡当锡（Luka Doncic）轰入45分、抓下今季新高15个篮板，另加6助攻5偷波，带领洛杉矶湖人主场131:125险胜多伦多速龙。当锡投中8球三分，连续第四场攻入最少37分，帮湖人在第三节初段领先26分。列夫斯（Austin Reaves）得19分，基斯拿（Walker Kessler）16分15篮板；湖人战绩改写为5胜2负。速龙在湖人收起正选嗰阵掀起反扑，最后43.7秒追到只差5分，最后功亏一篑。速龙的巴尼斯（Scottie Barnes）得29分、巴列特（RJ Barrett）22分；球队跌至3胜3负，卡维李安纳（Kawhi Leonard）膝伤连续缺阵第四场。

title.en: Boulter survives scare to reach Hong Kong Open last 16; Venus Williams opens evening session
title.zh_hant: 保特險勝過關晉級16強　雲露絲威廉絲今晚維園登場
title.zh_hans: 保特险胜过关晋级16强　云露丝威廉丝今晚维园登场

summary.en: The main draw of the Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open got under way at Victoria Park on Monday. Eighth seed Katie Boulter survived a scare in her first-round match, leading Viktorija Golubic by a set and 5-2 and serving for the match before being broken and forced into a tie-break, which she closed out 7-2 for a 6-2, 7-6 victory and a place in the last 16. She will meet American Claire Liu, who beat qualifier Tatiana Prozorova 6-2, 6-4 earlier in the day. Fourth seed Maria Sakkari eased past lucky loser Carol Young-suh Lee 6-1, 6-4 to reach the round of 16, while qualifier Aliaksandra Sasnovich beat Katie Volynets 6-3, 6-2. The evening session centres on 46-year-old former world No. 1 Venus Williams, who opens her campaign against 23-year-old fellow American Mary Stoiana from 6:30pm, bidding to end a 16-match losing streak stretching back to last season. Williams said she would leave no stone unturned in preparation and wanted to deliver her best on court. After Williams, local hope Adithya Karunaratne plays China star Wang Xinyu on his WTA Tour debut.
summary.zh_hant: 保誠香港網球公開賽今日喺維多利亞公園開打主賽圈。8號種子、英國「一姐」保特（Katie Boulter）喺首圈險些翻車——領先高露碧（Viktorija Golubic）一盤同5:2、發球勝賽局嗰陣連失發球局，被迫打決勝局，最終以6:2、7:6（7:2）過關晉級16強，下一輪將對陣美國嘅劉喬安娜（Claire Liu）。劉喬安娜同日以6:2、6:4擊敗資格賽球手柏哥娃（Tatiana Prozorova）。4號種子莎卡莉（Maria Sakkari）以6:1、6:4輕取幸運輸家 Carol Young-suh Lee，晉級16強；資格賽「二號種子」莎絲露碧琪（Aliaksandra Sasnovich）就以6:3、6:2淘汰禾連妮絲（Katie Volynets）。今晚焦點係46歲嘅前「世界一姐」雲露絲威廉絲（Venus Williams），佢喺6點半後嘅晚場登場，對陣23歲同胞史杜安娜（Mary Stoiana），爭取終結自去年起嘅16連敗；雲露絲賽前話會做足備戰，要畀自己交出最佳表現。雲露絲賽後，港隊希望阿迪雅加林拿特（Adithya Karunaratne）將迎戰中國球手王欣瑜，展開個人WTA巡迴賽首戰。
summary.zh_hans: 保诚香港网球公开赛今日在维多利亚公园开打主赛圈。8号种子、英国「一姐」保特（Katie Boulter）喺首圈险些翻车——领先高露碧（Viktorija Golubic）一盘同5:2、发球胜赛局嗰阵连失发球局，被迫打决胜局，最终以6:2、7:6（7:2）过关晋级16强，下一轮将对阵美国的刘乔安娜（Claire Liu）。刘乔安娜同日以6:2、6:4击败资格赛球手柏哥娃（Tatiana Prozorova）。4号种子莎卡莉（Maria Sakkari）以6:1、6:4轻取幸运输家 Carol Young-suh Lee，晋级16强；资格赛「二号种子」莎丝露碧琪（Aliaksandra Sasnovich）就以6:3、6:2淘汰禾连妮丝（Katie Volynets）。今晚焦点系46岁的前「世界一姐」云露丝威廉丝（Venus Williams），她在6点半后的晚场登场，对阵23岁同胞史杜安娜（Mary Stoiana），争取终结自去年起的16连败；云露丝赛前话会做足备战，要畀自己交出最佳表现。云露丝赛后，港队希望阿迪雅加林拿特（Adithya Karunaratne）将迎战中国球手王欣瑜，展开个人WTA巡回赛首战。
